definitions.explanation: A mistake or failure, especially one resulting from carelessness or lack of due care. Often used in legal contexts to distinguish from intentional wrongdoing.

examples.japanese: {過失|かしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よる→よる：09857_yoru⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{訴|うった}えられた→訴える：01891_uttaeru⟧。
examples.english: He was sued for an accident caused by negligence.

examples.japanese: {過失|かしつ}⟦{致死|ちし}→致死：10002_chishi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{起訴|きそ}された→起訴する：09863_kisosuru⟧。
examples.english: He was indicted for involuntary manslaughter.
examples.notes: [Note: 過失致死 = negligent homicide/involuntary manslaughter]

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{運転手|うんてんしゅ}→運転手：01333_untenshu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{過失|かしつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This accident was caused by the driver's negligence.

notes:
LEGAL CONTEXT: In Japanese law, {過失|かしつ} (negligence) is distinguished from {故意|こい} (intent). Crimes or liability based on negligence typically carry lighter penalties.

LEGAL TERMS:
・{過失|かしつ}{致死|ちし} (negligent homicide)
・{過失|かしつ}{傷害|しょうがい} (negligent injury)
・{過失|かしつ}{責任|せきにん} (liability for negligence)
・{重過失|じゅうかしつ} (gross negligence)
・{業務上|ぎょうむじょう}{過失|かしつ} (professional negligence)

CONTRAST:
・{過失|かしつ} (negligence, unintentional)
・{故意|こい} (intentional, deliberate)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{失敗|しっぱい} (failure, mistake - general)
・{ミス} (mistake - casual)
・{誤|あやま}り (error, mistake - general)
